verdicts.reason: A: the headline is readable and the colours are right, but the bottle-in-circle is a small crop jammed into the top-left corner. The NEW badge and Try It button are oversized and right-aligned, leaving left-aligned type above them with a dead lower-left quadrant, so the badge competes with the CTA. B: the white headline sits on the cream circle with almost no contrast and is nearly unreadable. The oversized bottle dominates the frame and spills below the circle, and the tiny buttons are under-weighted, so the hierarchy is broken despite a nicer composition idea.
